name: 46 Neighborhood Crips
description: 46 NeighborHood Crips (46NHC) are a predominantly African-American street gang originating in the 1970s on the West Side of South Central Los Angeles, in the area of 46th Street and Western Avenue. They fall under the Neighborhood Crips (Deuce 2X) and are often confused with the 46 Top Hustler Crips and the Rollin 40s Crips, which are three distinct gangs. In 2007, all three were included in a gang injunction to help cease gang-related activities. In 2010, the Los Angeles Unified School District opened Barack Obama Global Preparation Academy within the gang's territory, between Western Avenue and St. Andrews Place along 46th Street.
